name: SET domain containing 3, actin N3(tau)-histidine methyltransferase

function.text: SETD3 encodes actin-histidine N-methyltransferase. Annotated molecular activities include protein-L-histidine N-tele-methyltransferase activity and transcription coactivator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and actin filament organization.

function.text: SETD3 encodes actin-histidine N-methyltransferase. It is a protein-histidine N-methyltransferase that specifically mediates 3-methylhistidine (tele-methylhistidine) methylation of actin at 'His-73'. Histidine methylation of actin is required for smooth muscle contraction of the laboring uterus during delivery. It does not have protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity and probably only catalyzes histidine methylation of actin.
